data.name: MindScape: Verenna
data.detailed_description:
Mindscape: Verenna is a story-driven cyberpunk action adventure set in the ruins of a world transformed by catastrophe, corruption, and unchecked technology.

Play as Nova, a young woman with extraordinary genetic abilities and the power to generate devastating super-cellular energy. Hunted for what she is—and for what she may become—Nova must fight her way through the decaying city of Verenna while uncovering the truth behind her creation.

Explore neon-lit streets, ruined districts, industrial strongholds, and forgotten places buried beneath the city. Battle cybernetically enhanced enemies using fast side-scrolling combat, powerful energy attacks, and abilities that grow stronger as Nova’s journey unfolds.

The ruthless Reavers patrol the wasteland: part-human, part-machine raiders who serve a far greater threat. Looming behind them is General Khardek, a mechanized tyrant whose experiments have granted him terrifying power. He knows the truth about Nova—and intends to claim her abilities for himself.

Features

  • Fast-paced side-scrolling combat

  • Cyberpunk environments filled with danger and hidden secrets

  • Evolving energy powers and enhanced abilities

  • Ruthless Reavers and powerful mechanized enemies

  • A dark, character-driven story centered on identity, control, and survival

  • A fractured world where hope may be the most dangerous weapon of all

Nova was born to change the world.

But is the world ready to change?
